An unavailable result is an authority boundary, not a scientific negative about every possible Duskblade mechanism, autonomous balancing or P9. It does not select content, propose a candidate, implement, inspect support, simulate, reopen a closed family, authorise ML/RL, use protected seeds, accept issue 421 or issue a P9 receipt.

decisionRules.success: All immutable identities pass and exactly one class satisfies every eligibility attribute with all required producer, mediator, consumer, payoff, lifecycle, cost, Dusk, factor, interference, null and policy semantics frozen by evidence or the SSOT.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze only the one complete mechanism for a separately preregistered identity-first design. Do not implement product truth, inspect support, simulate, vary a payoff, add a joint cell, use ML/RL, use protected seeds or cross promotion here.
decisionRules.futility: All immutable identities pass, no class is autonomously eligible, and at least two materially distinct source-carrier classes with different lifecycles remain broadly authorised but require unspecified product semantics.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and record the post-fallback mechanism gate unavailable under current authority. Preserve source, ledger and protected seeds; publish the zero-row evidence and present one concise human-authority decision package containing the missing exact mechanism contract and materially different lifecycle options. Keep issue 421 as the single task. Do not invent or recommend an unfrozen candidate, create a successor, implement, simulate, add ML/RL or claim issue 421 or P9 acceptance.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable identity, source anchor, evidence decision, ledger identity or 30-second cap fails; more than one class is autonomously eligible; or the audit cannot establish either one complete mechanism or at least two distinct human-authority lifecycle classes.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the audit inconclusive at cap without selecting, implementing, simulating, inspecting support, repairing a closed result, adding a method or using protected seeds. Invoke only the current human-authority contract if no safe evidence-backed continuation remains.
